title: Coffee Freakshake
subtitle: An over-the-top Oreo coffee shake in a chocolate-lined glass, piled with ice cream and whipped cream.
protein: ~12g protein per glass — from milk and ice cream

method.title: Prepare the glass
items: Crush {@oreo:rim} and mix with {@choc-chips} on a plate
Drizzle {@choc-syrup:glass} around the inside and along the rim of a tall glass
Dip the rim in the crushed Oreo mix so it sticks
Chill the glass while you blend

method.label: Toddler — pour hers now (before the coffee)
items: Pour {=¼ cup} of the Oreo shake into her cup — a small chocolate milkshake, no caffeine

method.title: Add coffee and assemble
items: Add {@syrup} to the blender; blend again 10 seconds
Pour the coffee shake into the prepared glass
Serve at once with a wide straw and a spoon

method.label: Tip
method.text: Ranveer Brar's card lists only ingredients; the method here is built around them. Oreos are egg-free. For a thicker shake, freeze the milk in an ice tray first. A blender, no cooking.
